build_loop_with_phases: build a Loop instance with multiple phases for training and evaluation with periodic logging
add_phase_to_loop: add a phase to the Loop with done, score, summary tensors and checkpoint intervals
run_loop_schedule: run the Loop schedule in a session until max_step with automatic checkpointing
review_loop_add_phase: review the Loop add_phase method to understand how done and score tensors are validated
summarize_loop_run: summarize the Loop run method that yields mean scores and stores checkpoints periodically
